## Import



cls splunk deliver can be imported using the topicId#taskId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cls/splunkDeliver:SplunkDeliver example eb417b1d-fc00-46f2-85f7-47ca0848a6b3#716dae34-7eba-4b09-a3d9-6fe8e510e236
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
